messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Taking pantoprazole long-term may cause you to develop stomach growths called fundic gland polyps. Talk with your doctor about this risk.
If you use pantoprazole for longer than 3 years, you could develop a vitamin B-12 deficiency. Talk to your doctor about how to manage this condition if you develop it.
Common pantoprazole side effects may include:
- headache, dizziness;
- stomach pain, gas, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea;
- joint pain; or
- fever, rash, or cold symptoms (most common in children).
This is not a complete list of side effects and others may occur. Call your doctor for medical advice about side effects. You may report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088.
Triplet: ["pantoprazole", "has reporting instruction", "report side effects to FDA at 1-800-FDA-1088"]

The relation 'has reporting instruction' in the triplet is defined as 'Patients using the subject drug are instructed to report the specified adverse event or symptom to the designated authority or contact.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has side effect': The subject drug may cause the adverse effect or symptom specified by the object entity.
B. 'should inform doctor about': Patients taking the subject drug should tell their doctor about the condition or circumstance specified by the object entity.
C. 'use with caution in': The subject drug may be unsafe or require medical supervision for patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
D. 'has serious side effect': The subject drug may cause the serious or potentially dangerous adverse effect specified by the object entity that requires medical attention.
E. 'requires monitoring of': Patients taking the subject drug may need the medical test or monitoring specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
